{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Drop rows with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
# because they are invalid and likely missing data
trial_clean = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check the new size
print(f'Number of rows after removing sentinel values: {trial_clean.shape[0]}')

# Check the distribution of 'arm' in the cleaned data
print('\n--- Distribution of Arm in Cleaned Data ---')
print(trial_clean['arm'].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of 'severity' in the cleaned data
print('\n--- Distribution of Severity in Cleaned Data ---')
print(trial_clean['severity'].value_counts())

# Check baseline biomarker by arm in cleaned data
print('\n--- Baseline Biomarker by Arm in Cleaned Data ---')
print(trial_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline'].mean())

# Check final biomarker by arm in cleaned data
print('\n--- Final Biomarker by Arm in Cleaned Data ---')
print(trial_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_final'].mean())

# Check response by arm in cleaned data
print('\n--- Response by Arm in Cleaned Data ---')
print(trial_clean.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean())

# Check the difference in response rate between arms
response_control = trial_clean[trial_clean['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
response_treatment = trial_clean[trial_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
diff_response = response_treatment - response_control

print(f'Control response rate: {response_control:.3f}')
print(f'Treatment response rate: {response_treatment:.3f}')
print(f'Difference in response rate: {diff_response:.3f}')"}
